seo.description: Biossays C10 is a Snibe automated biochemistry analyzer with up to 3,000 tests/h across separate biochemistry and ISE channels. Supplied in Ukraine by LabWell.

T2_hero.lead: A Snibe analyzer with separate channels for biochemistry and ISE testing, plus support for whole-blood HbA1c measurement.

image.alt: Biossays C10 automated biochemistry analyzer by Snibe

T3_about.h2: What Biossays C10 is and who it is for
T3_about.text: Biossays C10 is an automated Snibe biochemistry analyzer for biochemistry and ISE testing. Its separate channels allow both areas to be managed on one instrument while preserving the throughput of each method. The analyzer also supports HbA1c measurement in whole blood.

items.text: Biochemistry and ISE testing run through separate channels. According to the manufacturer, this arrangement helps preserve the throughput of each method.
The instrument provides 300 sample positions and 200 reagent positions, allowing both to be loaded on the analyzer at the same time.
Biossays C10 supports HbA1c measurement in whole-blood samples alongside biochemistry and ISE testing.

testMenu.title: Snibe biochemistry test menu
testMenu.text: The Snibe menu contains 114 biochemistry tests in 13 groups. Ask a manager which tests apply to a specific model.

models.h2: Other Snibe biochemistry and electrolyte analyzers
models.text: Explore other Snibe models for biochemistry and electrolyte testing.

items.q: What is the throughput of Biossays C10?
items.a: The total throughput of Biossays C10 is up to 3,000 tests per hour. The biochemistry channel processes up to 2,000 tests per hour, while the ISE channel processes up to 1,000.

items.q: What testing does Biossays C10 perform?
items.a: Biossays C10 performs biochemistry and ISE testing through separate channels. Ask a manager which tests apply to this model.

items.q: How many positions does Biossays C10 provide?
items.a: The analyzer provides 300 sample positions and 200 reagent positions.

items.q: What is the minimum reaction volume for Biossays C10?
items.a: The minimum reaction volume is 70 µL.

items.q: Who supplies and maintains Biossays C10 in Ukraine?
items.a: LabWell is an official Snibe distributor in Ukraine. It helps select the most effective solution for your needs and provides supply, installation, staff training, warranty and post-warranty maintenance, and application support.

T12_contact.text: Tell us about your biochemistry and ISE workload and required tests, and we will help assess Biossays C10 for your laboratory and discuss its separate-channel workflow.
